verdict.rationale: AWS documents a Cost Explorer API for querying cost and usage data programmatically. It also documents Budgets and unified cost dashboards, so cost data is clearly more than a console screenshot. However, the pack has no evidence of scheduled exports or resource-level granularity, which are two of the story's three elements. Missing for 10: scheduled/recurring cost exports (e.g. a cost-and-usage report delivered to storage), documented resource-level granularity in API or exports, and independent hands-on corroboration of analyst querying workflows.
